section_summary.extract_value: This procedures section describes a Portuguese study conducted via Facebook using snowball sampling. The original sample comprised 392 participants (17 men, 375 women) aged 17-57, but after data cleaning excluding males and participants outside the 18-55 age range, the final sample consisted of 369 females. Participants completed self-report measures in 10-15 minutes after providing informed consent.
